prompt_text: Who is the best branding agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” branding agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry and preferred working style. I can make a targeted recommendation, but first I need a bit more about your project.

Quick questions so I can shortlist the best fits for you:
- What are you hiring for? (full brand strategy, visual identity, naming, packaging, website, ad campaigns, social, etc.)
- Industry / target audience (B2B, B2C, healthcare, education, retail, startups, enterprise)?
- Budget range (ballpark: <$10k, $10–50k, $50–150k, $150k+)?  
- Timeline (weeks, 1–3 months, 3–6 months)?
- Do you prefer a small boutique studio or a larger full‑service agency?
- Any must-haves (local presence, portfolio examples, prior category experience)?

If you want immediate, general guidance instead of answering those: I can provide a short list of highly regarded St. Louis agencies across categories (boutique identity studios, full‑service shops, digital/marketing specialists) with notes on what they’re best at and questions to ask each one. Which would you prefer?
